label: Levi lattice completion: W33 partial order → distributive lattice
motivation: Pass 4342 found a depth-4 partial causal order on the W33 Levi spanning tree. This pass attempts to complete it to a distributive lattice (Birkhoff's theorem: every distributive lattice is the lattice of downsets of a poset).

steps: Compute all down-sets (order ideals) of the depth-4 poset
Check distributivity: a ∧ (b ∨ c) = (a ∧ b) ∨ (a ∧ c)

birkhoff_representation.theorem: The distributive lattice of 2048 elements is isomorphic to J(P) — the poset of antichains of the depth-4 W33 Levi poset P.
birkhoff_representation.interpretation: The W33 Levi causal structure encodes exactly 11 bits of independent causal information.

machine_implication.interpretation: Machine D uses only 4/11 of the available Levi lattice causal bits. 7 bits of causal structure are unexploited — potential for Machine G (11-opcode maximally expressive).

machine_G_candidate.note: Requires Levi lattice navigation opcodes to access all 11 causal bits.

conclusion: The W33 Levi partial order completes to a distributive lattice of 2048 elements with rank 11. This lattice encodes 11 bits of causal information, of which Machine D exploits only 4. Machine G (candidate) would maximally use the Levi lattice causal structure.
